_comment: Deliberate differences scripts/check-abi.py accepts on every branch. Keep it short; each entry needs a reason in CLAUDE.md or the sys crate's docs.

_reasons.added_const_fields: input-only pointers, tightened to *const in manifold-csg-sys 3.5.101 (see CLAUDE.md, Versioning)
_reasons.enum_names: ManifoldError::VertexOutOfBounds predates the header's VERTEX_INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS naming
_reasons.opaque_handles: C++ objects the C API only hands out by pointer; declared in Rust as `_private: [u8; 0]` structs
